name: Never Grow Up
summary: Do you remember your favourite games you liked to play as a kid?  Never Grow Up lets you re-discover childhood play through a series of 7 mini-games -- but not alone! A goofy “minion” demands you play with it, too. This little troublemaker will be your companion, antagonist, nemesis and plaything. Time is limited as the ice cream monster's slime invades the scene while you figure out how to play together. In this game, a high score means a big loss.
